Jenna: hi folks :wave: received my Fedora 36 laptop from IT and hitting the usual onboarding snags. using asdf to install python 3.11 and ruby 3.2 but both fail linking openssl (ld: cannot find -lssl / -lcrypto). also trying to clone private dotfiles but the Okta SSO redirect opens a blank page. who do I ping for infra/SSO?
Carlos: welcome @Jenna! start by installing the -devel packages and pkg-config: `sudo dnf install -y openssl-devel zlib-devel xz-devel bzip2-devel libffi-devel gcc make pkgconfig`. then export paths before running `asdf install`:
```
export OPENSSL_DIR=/usr
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/lib64/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib64/pkgconfig
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib64:/usr/lib64
```
For ruby: `RUBY_CONFIGURE_OPTS="--with-openssl-dir=$OPENSSL_DIR" asdf install ruby 3.2.0`.
Priya: for the dotfiles/Okta issue, try cloning from a browser where you're already signed into Okta (open the repo URL in Chrome/Firefox first). if the redirect is blank, clear Okta cookies or open an incognito window, sign in, then retry the clone. alternatively ask IT to temporarily add your SSH key to the repo while they sort SSO.
Jenna: ran the dnf installs + exports, python 3.11 built fine. ruby still failed until I used the RUBY_CONFIGURE_OPTS — that fixed it, ruby 3.2 installed :tada:.
Jenna: Okta blank page was solved by clearing cookies and logging into our Okta org in Chrome; after that git clone worked and I could add my SSH key via the web UI.
Carlos: once you're cloned, make sure direnv is enabled in your shell if dotfiles expect it: add `eval "$(direnv hook bash)"` (or zsh/fish equivalent) to your rc. also run `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` if you generated a key.

Jenna: all green now, thanks for the quick help everyone :pray: will ping if more pops up.
